verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships a first-party `vastai` agent skill, installed with `npx skills add vast-ai/vast-cli --skill vastai`. It lets AI coding assistants drive the platform on the user's behalf: create instances, deploy endpoints, manage SSH keys and check balances. That gives real natural-language operation, but only through an external AI coding assistant, not a native natural-language interface in the console or CLI. missing for 10: a built-in natural-language interface in the product itself, documentation of the skill's full command coverage and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.
